description: Complete rewrite of all game scripts for the full JailBreak prototype. This single feature covers ALL game systems: expanded map, weapons (AK-47, M4A1, Shotgun, Pistol, Knife, Fists), health system, teams/rounds, door system, AI bots, full UI (HP bar, ammo, timer, kill feed, team menu, crosshair, interaction prompts), and game flow. The Editor script has ONE menu button 'JailBreak > Build Full Game' that creates everything.
steps: Step 1 - Create Scripts/Player/PlayerController.cs: Keep the existing FPS controller logic (WASD, mouse look, jump, sprint, crouch via New Input System) but add: weapon bob animation while walking, death state (disable input when dead), team assignment field, interaction raycast for doors/buttons (E key). Keep CharacterController-based movement.

Step 2 - Create Scripts/Health/HealthSystem.cs: MonoBehaviour with 100 HP max, TakeDamage(float, string attackerName) method, Die() that disables player input and enables spectate camera, heal method for medkits. Fires events for UI updates. Track if alive/dead.

Step 3 - Create Scripts/Health/DamageReceiver.cs: MonoBehaviour for any damageable entity (player, bots). Has a reference to HealthSystem or BotHealth. Provides a unified TakeDamage interface that raycasts can hit.

Step 4 - Create Scripts/Weapons/WeaponData.cs: Expand existing to include M4A1, Knife, Fists. Add fields: weaponType enum (Automatic, SemiAuto, Shotgun, Melee, Fists), isMelee flag, meleeRange, team restriction (Guard, Prisoner, Both). Static factory methods for all 6 weapons.

Step 5 - Create Scripts/Weapons/WeaponController.cs: Rewrite to support 6 weapons (Fists always slot 0, Knife slot 1, Pistol slot 2, then AK/M4/Shotgun slots 3-5). Add melee attack logic (short range sphere overlap), weapon bob while walking (sinusoidal offset to weaponHolder), recoil animation (kick back + recover), muzzle flash on fire. Integrate with HealthSystem for damage dealing. Check team restrictions (prisoners cant use guard weapons).

Step 6 - Create Scripts/Teams/TeamManager.cs: Singleton MonoBehaviour. Enum Team { Guard, Prisoner }. Manages team assignment, spawn points, team-specific weapon access. Tracks all team members (player + bots).

Step 7 - Create Scripts/Teams/RoundManager.cs: MonoBehaviour managing round lifecycle. 5-minute timer. Round states: WaitingToStart, RoundActive, RoundEnd. Start: cells closed, prisoners in cells, guards in guard room. Guards can open cells via button. End conditions: timer expires (guards win), all prisoners dead (guards win), prisoners rebel (kill all guards). Auto-restart rounds. Track scores.

Step 8 - Create Scripts/Doors/DoorController.cs: MonoBehaviour for animated doors. Types: CellDoor (bars, slide open, guard-only button), ArmoryDoor (guard-only keycard), RegularDoor (anyone with E). Open/close with Lerp animation. isOpen state, interaction range check.
Step 9 - Create Scripts/Doors/DoorButton.cs: MonoBehaviour for wall-mounted buttons that control cell doors. Shows 'Press E to open cells' prompt when guard is near. Only guards can activate.

Step 10 - Create Scripts/AI/BotController.cs: MonoBehaviour for AI bots. Has team assignment, waypoint-based patrol (move between Transform[] waypoints), state machine: Idle, Patrol, Follow, Attack. Detects enemies via raycast line-of-sight. Shoots at visible enemies. Guards patrol, prisoners follow orders or wander. Simple NavMesh-free movement (move toward waypoint, rotate toward target). Health component for taking damage.
Step 11 - Create Scripts/AI/BotHealth.cs: Simple health component for bots. 100 HP, TakeDamage, Die (disable bot, play death state), integrates with RoundManager to check win conditions on death.
Step 12 - Create Scripts/AI/BotSpawner.cs: Helper used by editor/round manager to spawn bots at designated points with team assignment and waypoint lists.

Step 13 - Create Scripts/UI/GameUI.cs: Single OnGUI MonoBehaviour that draws ALL HUD elements: HP bar (top-left, red bar with number), ammo counter (bottom-right), round timer (top-center, MM:SS format), team indicator (top-right, colored text), kill feed (top-right below team, last 5 kills fade out), crosshair (center, dynamic gap based on movement), 'Press E to interact' prompts, death overlay ('YOU DIED - spectating').
Step 14 - Create Scripts/UI/TeamSelectUI.cs: OnGUI menu shown at game start. Two buttons: 'Join Guards' and 'Join Prisoners'. Shows team descriptions. Locks cursor on selection and starts round.

Step 15 - Create Scripts/UI/KillFeed.cs: Tracks recent kills with attacker name, victim name, weapon used. Displays last 5 entries fading out over 5 seconds. Called by HealthSystem/BotHealth on death.

Step 16 - Create Scripts/GameFlow/GameManager.cs: Singleton that orchestrates everything. Holds references to RoundManager, TeamManager. Manages game state: TeamSelect, Playing, RoundEnd. Handles score tracking (guards wins vs prisoner wins).
Step 17 - Create Scripts/GameFlow/SpectateCamera.cs: When player dies, enables a free-flying camera or follows a random alive teammate. Uses WASD to fly around in spectate mode.

Step 18 - Create Scripts/Editor/JailBreakEditor.cs: COMPLETE REWRITE. Single menu item 'JailBreak/Build Full Game'. Builds EVERYTHING: (a) Full prison map with cell block (6 cells with beds, toilets, bars), main corridor, guard room with armory, outdoor yard with basketball court markings, ventilation shafts (crawl space connecting cells to yard), medic room, cafeteria with tables/benches, armory room (restricted), 2 watch towers in yard. (b) Player object with all components. (c) Bot spawn points and waypoints. (d) All doors with controllers. (e) Door buttons. (f) Weapon pickups placed logically. (g) UI objects. (h) Lighting throughout. (i) Team spawn points. All geometry from primitives with URP Lit materials in appropriate colors.
acceptance_criteria: All .cs files have valid C# syntax with proper using statements and no missing type references
All scripts use New Input System (UnityEngine.InputSystem) - no Input.GetAxis or Input.GetKey anywhere
All materials use Shader.Find("Universal Render Pipeline/Lit")
Editor script has exactly one menu item: JailBreak/Build Full Game
Editor script creates complete scene: map, player, bots, doors, UI, weapons, spawns
Prison map includes: 6 cells with furniture, corridor, guard room, armory, yard with court, ventilation shafts, medic room, cafeteria, watch towers
6 weapons defined: AK-47, M4A1, Shotgun, Pistol, Knife, Fists with correct stats
Health system with 100 HP, damage, death, and healing
Team system with Guard/Prisoner teams and spawn points
Round system with 5-min timer and win conditions
Door system with cell bars (guard button), armory door (guard only), regular doors (E key)
AI bots with patrol, line-of-sight detection, and shooting
Full HUD: HP bar, ammo, timer, team indicator, kill feed, crosshair, interaction prompts
Team selection menu at game start
All cross-references between scripts are correct (no missing GetComponent calls to nonexistent types)
File structure: Scripts/Editor/, Scripts/Player/, Scripts/Weapons/, Scripts/Health/, Scripts/Teams/, Scripts/Doors/, Scripts/AI/, Scripts/UI/, Scripts/GameFlow/
verification: Read every generated .cs file and verify valid C# syntax
Grep for 'Input.GetAxis' or 'Input.GetKey' to confirm zero usage of old input system
Grep for 'Universal Render Pipeline/Lit' to confirm URP shader usage in material creation
Verify the Editor script has [MenuItem("JailBreak/Build Full Game")] attribute
Check that all type references between files are consistent (no referencing classes that dont exist)
